title: Remove the remaining quadratic board-load callers (ready, dep add, dep tree, update --type)
description: Board load remainder of kbs-73f796e3: kbs ready, kbs dep add, kbs dep tree and kbs update --type still load or scan the board per issue. Make each load the board once per command in both runtimes, with identical output, and add a performance regression check alongside the existing performance CI job.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done: PR #541 merged with CI green (parity-exempt: Python-only fix matching Rust). Python single-file reads no longer rebuild the whole issues table; on 2,000 issues ready, dep tree, dep add and move went from about 170 s to under 1 s (Rust already linear). tools/check_board_load.py in the performance job guards both runtimes. update --type does not exist; the type change is kbs move.
